flyer.justification: The flyer captures key themes well with clear formatting and logistics, but the title exceeds the 6-word limit.

linkedin.justification: Meets all LinkedIn requirements cleanly without forbidden cliches or filler words, featuring a thoughtful discussion prompt and relevant hashtags.

newsletter.justification: Follows all newsletter formatting criteria with an under-50-character subject line, three bold subheadings, and engaging editorial tone.

summary.justification: A concise executive briefing strictly under 400 words that thoroughly covers the core evidence, discussion points, and action items.

instagram.justification: Effectively incorporates emojis, clear carousel cues, a call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

blog.justification: An excellent long-form blog post complete with numbered insight sections, comparison table, strong conclusion, and an author bio matching the profile.
